summary: Verified P2 bug fix for list-view multi-select parity with icon view. All 7 scenarios from the review request PASS. Seeded 4 TEST notes across Work/Personal via IndexedDB; ran end-to-end Playwright flows covering grouped list-view, flat list-view (group off), icon view regression, Batch Studio Duplicate & Delete, and multiselect-cancel exit. Whole-row tap toggles selection, chevron is hidden in select mode, indicator + indigo ring reflect selected state, MultiSelectBar shows correct count, Batch Studio sheet opens with correct '2 selected' header, Duplicate creates 2 ' (copy)' notes, Delete removes selected notes after AlertDialog confirmation, and exiting select mode restores accordion expand behaviour (Full screen action becomes visible).
critical_code_review_comments: Console noise (dev-only warning): '@hello-pangea/dnd — Invariant failed: Draggable[id: note-<id>]: Unable to find drag handle' is logged for every rendered note whenever select mode is active. Cause: in select mode AccordionNoteItem renders a <button> branch and does not spread `dragHandleProps` onto any element, while its parent <Draggable> in NotesApp.jsx still exists (line 906–924 flat, 74–95 CategoryGroup, 979–999 uncategorized). Suggested fix: when `selectMode` is true, attach `dragHandleProps` to a hidden but present element (e.g., a zero-size span with `style={{display:'none'}}`), OR pass `isDragDisabled` on the Draggable when in select mode. Purely dev-only warning today but pollutes console and could break future strict-mode / drag-library upgrades.

AccordionNoteItem.jsx (line 42): rings apply via 'ring-2 ring-indigo-400' — works, but consider adding an aria-pressed on the select button (currently the button has no aria-pressed), which would make selection state accessible.

MultiSelectBar.jsx returns null when count===0. That's fine, but the 'Selected 0' pill visible in header (from the toolbar toggle) may confuse users when nothing is picked; not a bug — just UX observation.
action_items: (P3) Silence '@hello-pangea/dnd Unable to find drag handle' console warnings while in select mode by either disabling the Draggable or attaching drag-handle props to an inert element.
test_credentials: N/A — offline PWA, IndexedDB db='IronRabbit', store='notes'
seed_data_creation: Seeded 4 notes directly into IronRabbit.notes via IndexedDB (2× Work, 2× Personal) with ids seed-1..4-<ts>. Duplicated rows during Batch Studio test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Key testids validated: multiselect-bar (only rendered when count>0), multiselect-studio-btn, multiselect-cancel, accordion-note-<id> (outer, always present), accordion-select-<id> (button, ONLY in select mode), accordion-select-indicator-<id>. Batch Studio: batch-studio-sheet header text is '<n> selected'; bs-duplicate creates copies via `handleClose` then `onDuplicate`; bs-delete opens confirm-bulk-delete which has confirm-bulk-delete-confirm / -cancel. Group toggle default is ON (aria-pressed='true'). When toggling group OFF and sortBy != 'custom', the fallback list at NotesApp.jsx line 1013 correctly renders AccordionNoteItem with selectMode. Icon tiles also have `note-tile-edit-<id>` inside `note-tile-<id>` — when clicking tiles use the outer tile selector, not '^=' which will match both.

verified_scenarios.flat-list-select-group-off: PASS — 4 accordion-select buttons rendered, tapping 2 rows shows '2 selected', indicators/rings applied
verified_scenarios.batch-studio-delete-from-list: PASS — confirm modal appears, delta = 2 removed after confirm
verified_scenarios.icon-view-regression: PASS — MultiSelectBar shows correct count and cancel clears state
verified_scenarios.accordion-expands-normally-out-of-select: PASS — clicking a row shows Full screen / Edit / Share / Delete action buttons
verified_scenarios.multiselect-cancel-exits-select: PASS — accordion-select-* buttons disappear, msb hidden, subsequent row click expands accordion

rca of the issue: Original bug was that AccordionNoteItem tapped rows only opened Collapsible instead of toggling selection. Fix (already in place) branches on `selectMode` — when true renders a plain <button> with onClick={onToggleSelect} and no CollapsibleTrigger. All three flat/grouped/uncategorized/fallback render sites in NotesApp.jsx correctly forward selectMode + isSelected + toggleSelect, and CategoryGroup forwards to child AccordionNoteItem. Verified end-to-end: fix is complete and correct.
